Hi I'm Leila the Pet Vet, 
Welcome or welcome back to my channel!  

This channel started as a way for me to share animal facts and my animal encounters. As I've gotten older, I also want to share my overall TWEEN experience since there isn't a lot of that happening on YouTube right now. So stick around as I share parts of my life, discuss tween topics,  share some tween fashion, while still sharing my love for animals. 

I will upload new videos every Friday at 3PM CST!

Please remember  to SUBSCRIBE and Click the Notification bell so that you know whenever a new video is uploaded. 

For business inquiries you can send an email to leilathepetvet@gmail.com

This channel is managed by my mom Dionne :)

Thanks for coming on this journey with me and I hope you love it!

BYEEEEE

Leila the Pet Vet
